title: Symptom-network dynamics in irritable bowel syndrome with comorbid panic disorder using electronic momentary assessment: A randomized controlled trial of escitalopram vs. placebo
limitations: - Small sample size; - Imbalance in sample size between groups; - Baseline differences between groups; - Multiple testing without correction; - Limited power due to high test burden of ESM.
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether code or data are publicly available. The authors mention that supplementary data can be found online, but do not specify availability of code or raw data. Preregistration status is not mentioned in the paper.
